content.eyebrow: Veterinary care with a calmer touch
content.title: Thoughtful care for pets and the people who love them
content.body: SMS Pet Clinic helps families keep pets healthy with preventive care, diagnostics, surgery support, and clear guidance at every visit.

image.alt: Veterinarian gently checking a calm dog

content.title: Everyday care, urgent help, and long-term health plans
content.body: A practical set of veterinary services built around prevention, early detection, and kind treatment.

items.title: Health Checks
items.body: Routine exams, vaccination plans, weight checks, and preventive care.

items.title: Diagnostics
items.body: Clear next steps through lab work, imaging referrals, and clinical review.

items.title: Surgery Support
items.body: Planned procedures, wound care, recovery guidance, and follow-up visits.

content.title: A clinic experience designed to feel less stressful
content.body: We keep visits calm, explain options clearly, and help pet owners make decisions with confidence. The result is care that feels personal without losing clinical precision.

image.alt: Clinic team with a pet owner

items.question: Do I need an appointment?
items.answer: Appointments help us reduce waiting time and prepare for your pet's needs. Urgent cases can be discussed by phone first.

items.question: What should I bring?
items.answer: Bring vaccination records, recent medication details, previous test reports, and a note of symptoms or behavior changes.

items.question: Can you help with long-term care plans?
items.answer: Yes. We can plan vaccination, nutrition, parasite control, dental care, and checkup schedules based on age and health.

content.title: Ready to plan your pet's next visit?
content.body: Tell us what is happening and we will guide you to the right appointment.
